pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside user need is turning recipe or food ideas into organized reusable content. This lane adapts that demand into an offline mobile browser artifact where users edit meal cards, tap meals into a fridge-week grid, balance cook time and spoilage risk, and copy/download a prep list. It is self-contained/offline so PathForge can mount it without APIs, hosted AI calls, CDN assets, remote fonts, or multi-file bundles.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but the file imports Lucide from a CDN and renders meal names or ingredients through innerHTML templates, which breaks my offline/safe-use requirement. Please return a corrected single HTML file with no external scripts, fonts, or assets, and render all editable meal text safely with textContent/createElement while keeping the tap-to-place fridge grid and copy/download prep list.
steps.response_summary: Gemini removed the CDN dependency, replaced icon-library usage with text/emoji controls, and rendered editable meal/card text via createElement/textContent while preserving the tap-to-place grid and prep-list export workflow.
